name: Highly Casual | 50mg Seltzer | Fruit With A Punch
description:
Big flavor. Bigger chill. Our latest heavy hitter takes classic fruit punch flavor and gives it a Highly Casual twist; bright, juicy, and packing a serious 50mg of premium Nano THC.

It’s the taste of Nostalgia, with the kind of buzz you only get as an adult. Sip it slow, or don’t — either way, it’s gonna hit.
